about:
OPT-IN, AND RUN ALONE: each test skips unless FJ_KBLOCK_FACTORED_STORE names
the store (measure.sh sets it to config.sh's MEASURE_KBLOCK_FACTORED_STORE,
the tracked data/measured/kblock_factored.json). It writes one row per
(arch, toolchain).

declared.hypothesis: holding E factored (three axis tables per side, each E_t formed at its read) removes the per-thread E blocks that keep (f, f)-pair K classes off the RTX 3080, at a cost of two multiplies per stage-2 read that may slow (dd|dd)
declared.rule: per arch: the median over the timed runs of the (dd|dd) class's events, factored / composed. 'accepted' when <= 1.05, 'regressed' when > 1.05; a regression is reported as the trade the f classes pay for, never hidden
declared.expected: neutral within the 5% band: the compilers already hoist the composed E^ac out of the ket loop (stack frames within 4% of each other at (dd|dd) and (ff|ss) before any row)
